1	/-

     6	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Gluing
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Gluing affine schemes from ring maps
    11	
    12	This file packages affine ring data into `Scheme.GlueData`.  The overlap restriction
    13	maps are the algebra maps `A i -> B i j`.  Thus an application with specified restriction
    14	maps should install the corresponding `Algebra (A i) (B i j)` structures (for example via
    15	`r.toRingHom.toAlgebra`) before invoking the constructor.
    16	
    17	The only non-formal coherence assumptions are ring identities:
    18	
    19	* each transition `tau i j : B j i -> B i j` is the identity on the diagonal;
    20	* the triple transition `theta i j k` sends the right tensor inclusion to the left
    21	  inclusion followed by `tau i j`;
    22	* the three cyclic triple transitions compose to the identity.
    23	
    24	The constructor conjugates `Spec.map theta` by Mathlib's `pullbackSpecIso`.  The face and
    25	cocycle fields of `Scheme.GlueData` are then discharged from the displayed ring identities.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
    33	open scoped TensorProduct
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicJacobian
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	variable {R J : Type u} [CommRing R]
    40	variable (A : J → Type u) (B : J → J → Type u)
    41	variable [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i j, CommRing (B i j)]
    42	variable [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)] [∀ i j, Algebra R (B i j)]
    43	variable [∀ i j, Algebra (A i) (B i j)]
    44	variable [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (A i) (B i j)]
    45	
    46	/-- The coordinate ring of the pullback of the two overlaps based at chart `i`. -/
    47	abbrev AffineTripleTensor (i j k : J) : Type u :=
    48	  B i j ⊗[A i] B i k
    49	
    50	/-- The left overlap inclusion into an affine triple tensor, viewed over `R`. -/
    51	def affineTensorIncludeLeft (i j k : J) :
    52	    B i j →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k :=
    53	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
    54	    B i j →ₐ[A i] B i j ⊗[A i] B i k).restrictScalars R
    55	
    56	/-- The right overlap inclusion into an affine triple tensor, viewed over `R`. -/
    57	def affineTensorIncludeRight (i j k : J) :
    58	    B i k →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k :=
    59	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
    60	    B i k →ₐ[A i] B i j ⊗[A i] B i k).restrictScalars R
    61	
    62	/-- The affine overlap inclusion induced contravariantly by `A i -> B i j`. -/
    63	abbrev affineRestriction (i j : J) :
    64	    Spec (CommRingCat.of (B i j)) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (A i)) :=
    65	  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A i) (B i j)))
    66	
    67	/-- The affine transition induced contravariantly by `tau i j : B j i -> B i j`. -/
    68	abbrev affineTransition (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j) (i j : J) :
    69	    Spec (CommRingCat.of (B i j)) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (B j i)) :=
    70	  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau i j).toRingHom)
    71	
    72	/-- The canonical affine chart for a triple pullback. -/
    73	abbrev affineTriplePullbackIso (i j k : J) :
    74	    pullback (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≅
    75	      Spec (CommRingCat.of (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)) :=
    76	  pullbackSpecIso (A i) (B i j) (B i k)
    77	
    78	/-- A ring map between the rotated triple tensor rings, conjugated into a morphism between
    79	the actual scheme pullbacks used by `Scheme.GlueData`. -/
    80	def affineTripleTransition
    81	    (theta : ∀ i j k,
    82	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
    83	    (i j k : J) :
    84	    pullback (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ⟶
    85	      pullback (affineRestriction A B j k) (affineRestriction A B j i) :=
    86	  (affineTriplePullbackIso A B i j k).hom ≫
    87	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta i j k).toRingHom) ≫
    88	      (affineTriplePullbackIso A B j k i).inv
    89	
    90	variable (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j)
    91	variable (theta : ∀ i j k,
    92	  AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
    93	
    94	/-- The right-face ring identity implies the factorization field of `Scheme.GlueData`. -/
    95	@[reassoc]
    96	theorem affineTripleTransition_fac
    97	    (hfac : ∀ i j k,
    98	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
    99	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j))
   100	    (i j k : J) :
   101	    affineTripleTransition A B theta i j k ≫
   102	        pullback.snd (affineRestriction A B j k) (affineRestriction A B j i) =
   103	      pullback.fst (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≫
   104	        affineTransition B tau i j := by
   105	  have hfac' :
   106	      CommRingCat.ofHom
   107	          (((theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i)).toRingHom) =
   108	        CommRingCat.ofHom
   109	          (((affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j)).toRingHom) :=
   110	    congrArg (fun f => CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) (hfac i j k)
   111	  simp only [affineTripleTransition, Category.assoc]
   112	  rw [pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd]
   113	  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   114	  change (pullbackSpecIso (A i) (B i j) (B i k)).hom ≫
   115	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   116	        (((theta i j k).comp
   117	          (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i)).toRingHom)) =
   118	      pullback.fst (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≫
   119	        affineTransition B tau i j
   120	  rw [hfac']
   121	  rw [show
   122	      ((affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j)).toRingHom =
   123	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).toRingHom.comp
   124	          (tau i j).toRingHom by rfl]
   125	  rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp]
   126	  change (pullbackSpecIso (A i) (B i j) (B i k)).hom ≫
   127	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   128	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom :
   129	          B i j →+* AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)) ≫
   130	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau i j).toRingHom) =
   131	      pullback.fst (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≫
   132	        affineTransition B tau i j
   133	  rw [← Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_hom_fst]
   134	
   135	/-- A cyclic identity of triple-tensor ring maps implies the scheme-level cocycle. -/
   136	theorem affineTripleTransition_cocycle
   137	    (hcycle : ∀ i j k,
   138	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   139	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k))
   140	    (i j k : J) :
   141	    affineTripleTransition A B theta i j k ≫
   142	        affineTripleTransition A B theta j k i ≫
   143	          affineTripleTransition A B theta k i j =
   144	      𝟙 (pullback (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k)) := by
   145	  have hmap :
   146	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta i j k).toRingHom) ≫
   147	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta j k i).toRingHom) ≫
   148	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta k i j).toRingHom) =
   149	        𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k))) := by
   150	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   151	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   152	    have hcycle' :
   153	        CommRingCat.ofHom
   154	            (((theta i j k).comp
   155	              ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j))).toRingHom) =
   156	          CommRingCat.ofHom
   157	            ((AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)).toRingHom) :=
   158	      congrArg (fun f => CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) (hcycle i j k)
   159	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   160	      (((theta i j k).comp
   161	        ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j))).toRingHom)) =
   162	      𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)))
   163	    rw [hcycle']
   164	    rw [show (AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)).toRingHom =
   165	      RingHom.id (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k) by rfl]
   166	    rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
   167	  simp only [affineTripleTransition, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
   168	  rw [reassoc_of% hmap]
   169	  exact Iso.hom_inv_id _
   170	
   171	/-- A diagonal identity of overlap ring maps gives the diagonal transition identity. -/
   172	theorem affineTransition_self
   173	    (htau : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i)) (i : J) :
   174	    affineTransition B tau i i = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of (B i i))) := by
   175	  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau i i).toRingHom) = _
   176	  rw [htau]
   177	  rw [show (AlgHom.id R (B i i)).toRingHom = RingHom.id (B i i) by rfl]
   178	  rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
   179	
   180	/-- Construct `Scheme.GlueData` from affine ring charts, overlap maps, and algebraic
   181	transition coherences.  Openness and the diagonal isomorphism remain geometric assumptions;
   182	the transition identity, factorization, and cocycle are discharged from ring equations. -/
   183	def affineRingGlueData
   184	    (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j)
   185	    (theta : ∀ i j k,
   186	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
   187	    (fId : ∀ i, IsIso (affineRestriction A B i i))
   188	    (fOpen : ∀ i j, IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j))
   189	    (tauId : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i))
   190	    (thetaFac : ∀ i j k,
   191	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
   192	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j))
   193	    (thetaCocycle : ∀ i j k,
   194	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   195	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)) :
   196	    Scheme.GlueData.{u} := by
   197	  letI (i j : J) : IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j) := fOpen i j
   198	  exact
   199	    { J := J
   200	      U := fun i => Spec (CommRingCat.of (A i))
   201	      V := fun p => Spec (CommRingCat.of (B p.1 p.2))
   202	      f := affineRestriction A B
   203	      f_id := fId
   204	      f_open := fOpen
   205	      t := affineTransition B tau
   206	      t_id := affineTransition_self B tau tauId
   207	      t' := affineTripleTransition A B theta
   208	      t_fac := affineTripleTransition_fac A B tau theta thetaFac
   209	      cocycle := affineTripleTransition_cocycle A B theta thetaCocycle }
   210	
   211	/-- The algebra structure maps on the affine charts descend to a structure map on the
   212	glued scheme. -/
   213	def affineRingGluedMap
   214	    (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j)
   215	    (theta : ∀ i j k,
   216	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
   217	    (fId : ∀ i, IsIso (affineRestriction A B i i))
   218	    (fOpen : ∀ i j, IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j))
   219	    (tauId : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i))
   220	    (thetaFac : ∀ i j k,
   221	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
   222	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j))
   223	    (thetaCocycle : ∀ i j k,
   224	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   225	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)) :
   226	    (affineRingGlueData A B tau theta fId fOpen tauId thetaFac thetaCocycle).glued ⟶
   227	      Spec (CommRingCat.of R) := by
   228	  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
   229	  · intro i
   230	    change J at i
   231	    exact Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (A i)))
   232	  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩
   233	    change J at i j
   234	    change
   235	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A i) (B i j))) ≫
   236	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (A i))) =
   237	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau i j).toRingHom) ≫
   238	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A j) (B j i)))) ≫
   239	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (A j)))
   240	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   241	    rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   242	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   243	    congr 1
   244	    ext r
   245	    simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
   246	      ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
   247	      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, Category.assoc, RingHom.coe_coe]
   248	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (A i) (B i j)]
   249	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (A j) (B j i)]
   250	    exact (tau i j).commutes r |>.symm
   251	
   252	/-- Each affine chart inclusion lies over its canonical structure map. -/
   253	@[reassoc]
   254	theorem affineRingGlueData_ι_affineRingGluedMap
   255	    (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j)
   256	    (theta : ∀ i j k,
   257	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
   258	    (fId : ∀ i, IsIso (affineRestriction A B i i))
   259	    (fOpen : ∀ i j, IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j))
   260	    (tauId : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i))
   261	    (thetaFac : ∀ i j k,
   262	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
   263	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j))
   264	    (thetaCocycle : ∀ i j k,
   265	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   266	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k))
   267	    (i : J) :
   268	    (affineRingGlueData A B tau theta fId fOpen tauId thetaFac thetaCocycle).ι i ≫
   269	        affineRingGluedMap A B tau theta fId fOpen tauId thetaFac thetaCocycle =
   270	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (A i))) :=
   271	  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _
   272	
   273	/-- The scheme obtained by gluing affine `R`-algebras, retained as an object over
   274	`Spec R`. -/
   275	def affineRingGluedOver
   276	    (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j)
   277	    (theta : ∀ i j k,
   278	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
   279	    (fId : ∀ i, IsIso (affineRestriction A B i i))
   280	    (fOpen : ∀ i j, IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j))
   281	    (tauId : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i))
   282	    (thetaFac : ∀ i j k,
   283	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
   284	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j))
   285	    (thetaCocycle : ∀ i j k,
   286	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   287	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)) :
   288	    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :=
   289	  Over.mk (affineRingGluedMap A B tau theta fId fOpen tauId thetaFac thetaCocycle)
   290	
   291	end
   292	
   293	end AlgebraicJacobian

     1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors. All rights reserved.

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.FiniteInAffine
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Group.Smooth
     8	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Cartesian.Grp
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Finite subsets of irreducible algebraic groups lie in affine opens
    12	
    13	This file formalizes the irreducible, algebraically closed core of
    14	[Stacks, Lemma 39.8.6](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B7S). Translation
    15	turns one affine neighborhood of the identity into finitely many dense open
    16	subsets. Irreducibility gives a common closed point, and translating back gives
    17	one affine open containing the prescribed rational points.
    18	
    19	The final theorem applies this argument to arbitrary finite sets of topological
    20	points: local finite type over a field makes the scheme Jacobson, so each point
    21	specializes to a closed point. It deliberately does not assert the remaining
    22	arbitrary-field or reducible-component descent.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits
    30	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory MonObj
    31	open scoped CategoryTheory.MonObj
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme
    34	
    35	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
    36	
    37	/-- Right translation by a rational point of a group scheme. -/
    38	noncomputable def rightMul (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    39	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ⟶ G :=
    40	  lift (𝟙 G) (toUnit G ≫ p) ≫ μ
    41	
    42	lemma comp_rightMul {G Z : Over (Spec (.of K))} [GrpObj G]
    43	    (x : Z ⟶ G) (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) :
    44	    x ≫ rightMul G p = x * (toUnit Z ≫ p) := by
    45	  rw [rightMul, ← Category.assoc, comp_lift, Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc,
    46	    CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    47	
    48	/-- Right translation is inverted by translation by the inverse point. -/
    49	noncomputable def rightMulIso (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    50	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ≅ G where
    51	  hom := rightMul G p
    52	  inv := rightMul G (p ≫ ι)
    53	  hom_inv_id := by
    54	    rw [comp_rightMul, rightMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    55	    change ((𝟙 G) * (toUnit G ≫ p)) * (toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹ = 𝟙 G
    56	    simp
    57	  inv_hom_id := by
    58	    rw [comp_rightMul, rightMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    59	    change ((𝟙 G) * (toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹) * (toUnit G ≫ p) = 𝟙 G
    60	    simp
    61	
    62	/-- Left translation by a rational point of a group scheme. -/
    63	noncomputable def leftMul (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    64	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ⟶ G :=
    65	  lift (toUnit G ≫ p) (𝟙 G) ≫ μ
    66	
    67	lemma comp_leftMul {G Z : Over (Spec (.of K))} [GrpObj G]
    68	    (x : Z ⟶ G) (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) :
    69	    x ≫ leftMul G p = (toUnit Z ≫ p) * x := by
    70	  rw [leftMul, ← Category.assoc, comp_lift, Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc,
    71	    CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    72	
    73	/-- Left translation is inverted by translation by the inverse point. -/
    74	noncomputable def leftMulIso (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    75	    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) : G ≅ G where
    76	  hom := leftMul G p
    77	  inv := leftMul G (p ≫ ι)
    78	  hom_inv_id := by
    79	    rw [comp_leftMul, leftMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    80	    change (toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹ * ((toUnit G ≫ p) * (𝟙 G)) = 𝟙 G
    81	    simp
    82	  inv_hom_id := by
    83	    rw [comp_leftMul, leftMul, ← CategoryTheory.Hom.mul_def]
    84	    change (toUnit G ≫ p) * ((toUnit G ≫ p)⁻¹ * (𝟙 G)) = 𝟙 G
    85	    simp
    86	
    87	lemma point_comp_rightMul_eq_point_comp_leftMul
    88	    (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    89	    (p q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) :
    90	    p ≫ rightMul G q = q ≫ leftMul G p := by
    91	  rw [comp_rightMul, comp_leftMul]
    92	  simp
    93	
    94	/-- Over an algebraically closed field, finitely many rational points of an
    95	irreducible locally algebraic group lie in one affine open. -/
    96	theorem exists_affineOpen_finset_points_of_irreducible
    97	    (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G] [IsAlgClosed K]
    98	    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] [IrreducibleSpace G.left]
    99	    (s : Finset (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G)) :
   100	    ∃ A : G.left.affineOpens,
   101	      ∀ p ∈ s, p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) ∈ A.1 := by
   102	  classical
   103	  let e : G.left := η[G].left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)
   104	  obtain ⟨U, hUa, heU, -⟩ :=
   105	    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp G.left.isBasis_affineOpens)
   106	      (show e ∈ (⊤ : G.left.Opens) from trivial)
   107	  let A : G.left.affineOpens := ⟨U, hUa⟩
   108	  let V : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))) ⟶ G) → Set G.left :=

+import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.QuasiProjectiveFiniteInAffine
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluedOver
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0GaloisAction
+
+/-!
+# Orbit affineness for the finite-stage Picard glue
+
+A projective finite-stage glued representative has the finite-in-affine property, so every
+orbit of its canonical finite-Galois action lies in an affine open.  This file records that
+producer at the exact carrier `P.gluedOver` used by finite-stage descent.
+
+The projectivity argument is deliberately explicit.  The affine-chart glue package does not
+yet construct `P.gluedMap.IsProjective`; that geometric certificate remains the sole input of
+this bridge rather than being hidden in an auxiliary class.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory
+open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {K k F : Type u} [Field K] [Field k] [Field F]
+variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
+variable (C : Over (Spec (.of K)))
+variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
+  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+variable (Ck : Over (Spec (.of k)))
+variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
+  [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
+
+/-- Projectivity of the finite-stage glued morphism supplies orbit affineness for the
+canonical action attached to a representation of Picard zero by that exact glue. -/
+@[implicit_reducible]
+noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective
+    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
+    [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
+    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
+    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
+    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
+  Scheme.orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine _
+    (Scheme.finiteInAffine_of_isProjective hproj)
+
+end
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry

+/-
+Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors. All rights reserved.
+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
+-/
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageOrbitAffine
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteGaloisRepresentable
+
+/-!
+# Stable affine covers from the finite-stage Picard glue
+
+This module immediately consumes finite-stage orbit affineness in the stable-cover engine and
+in the finite-Galois Picard representability theorem.  The only additional geometric input is
+the projectivity certificate exposed by `pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective`.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
+open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {K k F : Type u} [Field K] [Field k] [Field F]
+variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
+variable (C : Over (Spec (.of K)))
+variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
+  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+variable (Ck : Over (Spec (.of k)))
+variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
+  [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
+variable (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
+variable [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
+
+/-- The finite-stage projectivity certificate produces the stable affine cover used by the
+finite-Galois quotient construction. -/
+@[implicit_reducible]
+noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageHasStableAffineCover_of_isProjective
+    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
+    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
+    HasStableAffineCover K P.N.1
+      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) := by
+  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
+    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj
+  infer_instance
+
+/-- Consume the finite-stage orbit-affineness producer in the finite-Galois Picard descent
+theorem.  The resulting quotient represents Picard zero over the original field. -/
+noncomputable def pic0RepresentableBy_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isProjective
+    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
+    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
+    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
+      (StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
+        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) := by
+  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
+    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj
+  exact pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent C rep
+
+end
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# Finite subsets of quasi-projective schemes lie in affine opens
    12	
    13	This module derives `Scheme.FiniteInAffine` from projectivity over an affine
    14	base. It does not construct a quasi-projectivity witness for any Picard scheme.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    24	
    25	/-- `FiniteInAffine` descends along open immersions. -/
    26	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isOpenImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    27	    [IsOpenImmersion f] (hY : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    28	  classical
    29	  intro s hs
    30	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hY (f.base '' s) (hs.image f.base)
    31	  letI : Fintype s := hs.fintype
    32	  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrle⟩ :=
    33	    AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite U.2
    34	      (fun x : s => f.base x)
    35	      (fun x => hU ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩)
    36	      (fun x => Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨(x : X), rfl⟩)
    37	  refine ⟨⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ Y.basicOpen r,
    38	    (U.2.basicOpen r).preimage_of_isOpenImmersion f hrle⟩, ?_⟩
    39	  intro x hx
    40	  change f.base x ∈ Y.basicOpen r
    41	  exact hr ⟨x, hx⟩
    42	
    43	/-- `FiniteInAffine` descends along arbitrary immersions. -/
    44	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    45	    [IsImmersion f] (hY : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    46	  obtain ⟨Z, g₁, g₂, hg₁, hg₂, -⟩ :=
    47	    (AlgebraicGeometry.IsImmersion.isImmersion_iff_exists (f := f)).mp
    48	      (inferInstance : IsImmersion f)
    49	  haveI := hg₁
    50	  haveI := hg₂
    51	  exact finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom g₁
    52	    (finiteInAffine_of_isOpenImmersion g₂ hY)
    53	
    54	/-- Relative projective space over an affine base satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    55	theorem finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace (n : Type u) (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S] :
    56	    FiniteInAffine (ProjectiveSpace n S) := by
    57	  haveI : IsAffineHom (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt n S) := by
    58	    rw [ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt_eq_snd]
    59	    exact MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ inferInstance
    60	  exact finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt n S)
    61	    (finiteInAffine_proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ)))
    62	
    63	/-- A scheme projective over an affine base satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    64	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isProjective {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] {π : X ⟶ S}
    65	    (h : π.IsProjective) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    66	  obtain ⟨n, -, i, hi, -⟩ := h
    67	  haveI := hi
    68	  exact finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom i (finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace n S)

    38	/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
    39	theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    40	    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    41	    Function.Surjective f.base := by
    42	  intro y
    43	  let s : ToType ((yoneda.obj Y).obj (op (Spec (Y.residueField y)))) :=
    44	    Y.fromSpecResidueField y
    45	  have hmem := h.imageSieve_mem s
    46	  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    47	    (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hmem
    48	  obtain ⟨r⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (Y.residueField y)))
    49	  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := cover.exists_eq r
    50	  have hi : (Presieve.ofArrows cover.X cover.f) (cover.f i) := ⟨i⟩
    51	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) hi
    52	  change q ≫ f = cover.f i ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y at hq
    53	  refine ⟨q.base z, ?_⟩
    54	  have hqz := congrArg (fun g : cover.X i ⟶ Y => g.base z) hq
    55	  change f.base (q.base z) = (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).base ((cover.f i).base z) at hqz
    56	  rw [hz, Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply] at hqz
    57	  exact hqz

events.text: There is a meaningful but limited deduction hidden in the construction: the glue index is finite and every chart is affine, so quasi-compactness of the glued scheme may be recoverable from the generated open cover. I’m checking Mathlib’s gluing API for that exact conclusion and, separately, whether local finite presentation of the descended chart algebras has actually been lifted to `P.gluedMap`. Neither would by itself imply projectivity, but they clarify the strongest available geometry.

The available `IsProjective` notion is concrete: a closed immersion into some finite-dimensional relative projective space. Properness plus an ordinary immersion into such a projective space suffices, while `FiniteInAffine` needs only the immersion. The finite-stage package currently supplies affine charts and open overlap maps, but no global immersion; I’m checking whether the scalar-extension comparison reaches the exact Picard representer strongly enough to descend either properness or such an immersion.

After an etale cover, represent the Picard class by an invertible sheaf and apply the fixed admissible translation, obtaining an invertible sheaf of degree \(n_{\mathrm{adm}}\). Its first cohomology vanishes by Theorem 1132, so its pushforward is locally free, commutes with base change, and has positive rank. The projective bundle of rank-one quotients of the dual pushforward is smooth and surjective over the test. It therefore has a section after a further etale cover. The corresponding nowhere-zero fibrewise section of the invertible sheaf cuts out a relative effective divisor whose translated Abel class is the original class.
